name: Notes
summary: Markdown notes in a folder you choose. A Node app written for Electron, ported by changing one line.
asks: A folder to keep the notes in (read and write)
A folder where exported pages are delivered (write only)

name: Todo
summary: A small to-do list with a C# engine. Everything stays in the app's own private storage.
asks: Nothing: no folders, no internet

name: Hasher
summary: Computes a SHA-256 fingerprint for every file in a folder you pick, with an engine written in Rust.
asks: Whichever folder you pick in its dialog (read only)

name: Particles
summary: A million-particle showcase. The window draws on your Mac's GPU at full speed while the scene is computed inside the VM.
asks: Nothing: no folders, no internet

name: Desk Helper
summary: A computer-use demo that can look at your screen, click and type for you, and use tools you register. Every power is off until you grant it.
asks: Your screen (only when you press its button)
Pointer and keyboard (only when you press its buttons)
Host tools and MCP servers you register yourself

name: Code - OSS (VS Code)
summary: VS Code 1.142.0 built from its open source, with its server, terminal, extensions and git all inside a VM. It sees only the folders you share.
asks: The project folder you open (read and write)
The internet, any public site (git, npm, extensions); never your local network
Your clipboard, and opening local servers in your browser

name: Terminal
summary: A shell and Google's Gemini CLI inside a VM. They can touch only the folder you grant and reach only the Google API host you allow.
asks: A project folder (read and write)
generativelanguage.googleapis.com (Google's Gemini service)

name: Local LLM
summary: Chat with a language model that runs on your own Mac. Your conversations never leave it. The only internet use is downloading the model you pick.
asks: huggingface.co (to download a model)
Optionally your Mac's GPU

name: Ollama
summary: The real Ollama server, in a VM. Chat with models that run on your Mac; pull them from Ollama's model registry.
asks: registry.ollama.ai and its storage host (to pull models)

name: Ollama Desktop
summary: Ollama's own desktop app, window and backend, built from Ollama's source and run in a VM. A good example of converting an existing app.
asks: Ollama's model registry and storage
ollama.com (optional: sign-in, cloud models)

name: Ollama (GPU, experimental)
summary: The Ollama sample using your Mac's GPU through an experimental Vulkan backend. Without the GPU switched on and allowed, it runs on the CPUs.
asks: Ollama's model registry and storage
Your Mac's GPU (experimental, off until you turn it on)
